findings.summary: Receipt-count mismatch, non-blocking: the product commit message says 'make verify (lint + 3081 tests + conformance, exit 0)' and 'No tests deleted: 3078 -> 3081', while the sealed verification record in the implement handoff counts total 3079 (3078 passed, 0 failed, exit_code 0). The DoD is exit-code based and is met; the delta is most plausibly environment-dependent skips (the suite skips on missing systemd-analyze/agent-runtime/schemas/port availability).
